library_subtitle: Copies of your reports on this computer. They open and work even when the platform is unavailable.
sync_manifest: Asking the platform what has changed…
sync_server_unavailable: The platform is unavailable right now. The reports below open from the copies on this computer — I will try again in {p1}.
sync_no_key: To keep the copies up to date, add an access key. Until then you can still read what has already been downloaded.
sync_key_expired: The access key has expired. Get a new one on the platform and add it here — reports already downloaded still open.
sync_key_rejected: The platform did not accept the access key. Check that it was copied in full, or get a new one.
sync_schedule_off: The reports below open and read from the copies on this computer. The program will not update them right now: scheduled updates are not running. Close the program and start it again.
sync_no_disk_space: Not enough disk space — {p1} more is needed. Free some space and run the update again; what has already been downloaded is intact.
sync_mirror_full: The mirror is full — {p1} short. You do not need to free disk space: this is the limit set for the copies themselves. Remove reports you do not need or ask for a larger limit.
report_outdated: The platform has a newer version — copy from {p1}
report_local_only: Changed here {p1}, not sent to the platform
report_not_downloaded: No copy yet — it will appear after the next update
report_skipped_rls: This report shows each person only their own rows, so it has no single copy. Open it on the platform when it is available. This is not an error.
report_skipped_draft: The report has not been published on the platform yet, so it has no copy.
local_update_blocked_rights: Data updates are paused: the platform has not confirmed your rights since {p1}. You can still read the report; updates will work again once the platform is reachable.
library_empty_hint: Add an access key and run the update — the program will download the reports you have access to and keep them fresh on its own.
library_empty_no_access: The update finished, but there are no reports available to you on the platform yet.
key_hint_where: The key is issued on the platform: open your profile and click “Key for the desktop program”.
key_hint_once: The key is shown only once, right after it is issued. If you did not copy it in time, issue a new one — the old one can be revoked in the same place.
key_hint_scope: The key only lets the program read your reports — nothing can be changed or published with it. Valid for {p1} days.
local_run_progress: Building the report from folders: {p1} of {p2}
local_run_done: Done: the report was rebuilt on this computer. It has not been published to the platform yet.
local_run_err_busy: The program is busy with another run — wait for it to finish.
local_run_err_rls: This report shows each person only their own rows — it is not updated locally.
local_run_err_no_right: The platform has not given you the right to update this report's data.
local_run_err_rights_expired: Your rights have not been confirmed since the last contact with the platform — updating is paused. You can still read the report.
local_run_err_no_bundle: The program has not downloaded this report's calculation part yet. It will arrive with the next contact with the platform — after that you can update without it.
local_run_err_no_generator: Nobody rebuilds this report on a schedule — there is nothing to update it with.
local_run_err_gp_bundle: This report is built from the data warehouse, not from folders on your computer: it cannot be updated without a connection.
local_run_err_no_agent: Update from folders is unavailable right now: the program was started without its calculation part.
local_only_no_bridge: This report gets its data from the platform, so on this computer it will show empty sections. The numbers are built and waiting to be published.
catchup_title: Built here, not published to the platform
catchup_question: The report was rebuilt on this computer {p1}. Publish it to the platform?
catchup_how: The report page publishes it: open it on the platform — it will collect the built files from this program and publish a new version. The version note will carry both dates: when it was built and when it was published.
action_publish_on_platform: Open the report on the platform
catchup_waiting: The report was rebuilt on this computer {p1}. The numbers are saved; you can publish them to the platform once it responds — the program will ask you here.
